fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential processes activity of N-Able Advanced Monitoring Agent RMM tool
fields.name: Potential N-Able Advanced Monitoring Agent RMM Tool Process Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path="*Agent_*_RW.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "BASEClient.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "BASupApp.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "BASupSrvc.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "BASupSrvcCnfg.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "BASupTSHelper.exe") or (tgt.process.image.path="*Agent_*_RW.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "BASEClient.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "BASupApp.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "BASupSrvc.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "BASupSrvcCnfg.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "BASupTSHelper.exe")))
